title: Simulation-Aware In-Context Policy Improvement for LLM-Aided Analog Layout Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2608.13767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analog IC layout design remains a labor-intensive iterative process dominated by simulation-driven refinement. Although end-to-end layout generators accelerate initial placement and routing, they still require experts to manually tune layout optimization parameters with repeated post-layout simulations for stringent design specifications. While Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely adopted for parameter tuning in analog IC design, at the layout level it typically requires hundreds to thousands of evaluations, each involving costly parasitic extraction and post-layout simulation, which makes it impractical. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in improving the sample efficiency of such simulation-driven tuning. translated_title: 仿真感知的上下文策略改进用于大语言模型辅助的模拟版图优化
translated_abstract: 模拟集成电路版图设计仍然是一个劳动密集型的迭代过程，主要由仿真驱动的优化所主导。尽管端到端的版图生成器加速了初始布局和布线，但对于严格的规格要求，专家仍需手动调整版图优化参数，并反复进行后布局仿真。虽然贝叶斯优化在模拟IC设计中广泛用于参数调整，但在版图层面，它通常需要数百到数千次评估，每次涉及昂贵的寄生提取和后布局仿真，使其不切实际。近期，大语言模型在提高此类仿真驱动调优的样本效率方面展现出潜力。然而，其对几何版图上下文和设计特定启发式信息的有限访问，限制了其操纵版图优化过程的能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种仿真感知的方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种仿真感知的上下文策略改进方法，利用大语言模型提升模拟版图优化的样本效率，以克服传统贝叶斯优化在版图层面需大量昂贵仿真评估的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simulation-aware in-context policy improvement method that leverages large language models to enhance sample efficiency in analog layout refinement, addressing the impractical cost of Bayesian optimization at the layout level.
